sloka: स चाभिषिक्तः क्षणदाचरैस्तदा निवेशयामास पुरीं दशाननः ।निकामपूर्णा च बभूव सा पुरी निशाचरैर्नीलबलाहकोपमैः ।। ७.११.५१ ॥
transliteration: sa cābhiṣiktaḥ kṣaṇadācaraistadā niveśayāmāsa purīṁ daśānanaḥ ।nikāmapūrṇā ca babhūva sā purī niśācarairnīlabalāhakopamaiḥ ।। 7.11.51 ॥

translations.english: After being crowned by the Rakshasas, Ravana then populated that city, and it became completely filled with night-wanderers resembling dark clouds.
